title: Add thousand separator to value in hits template
body:
Hey all, I'm trying to figure out a way to add a thousand separator comma into a 'price' in the hits template but it's now driving me crazy! I've been trying / looking into many ways over the last few hours and learning Mustache but can't figure out the best approach.

Any help would be hugely grateful.

comments.body: Hi @JonnyTurnerUK I am sorry you wasted that much time. First, did you had a look at our documentation about hogan helpers? https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#helpers
That's awesome!! I've read through the docs but think I got distracted with transformData and got totally confused. Been practicing with the hogan helpers so many thanks fo help! Chuffed!
